query.name: build-queue-list
query.comment: Get a description of the build queue
query.sql: SELECT queue.id AS id, queue.`order` AS `order`, queue.create_date AS create_date, queue.building AS building, project.name AS name, project.status AS status, branch.name AS branch_name, branch.tag AS branch_tag, branch.status AS branch_status, recipe.id AS recipe_id, recipe.name AS recipe_name, recipe.status AS recipe_status, recipe.main_recipe AS main_recipe, node.name AS node_name, node.status AS node_status FROM porion_build_queue AS queue INNER JOIN porion_node AS node ON queue.node_id = node.id INNER JOIN porion_recipe AS recipe ON queue.recipe_id = recipe.id INNER JOIN porion_project AS project ON recipe.project_id = project.id INNER JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON recipe.branch_id = branch.id ORDER BY queue.`order` ASC, queue.create_date ASC
query.sql-count: SELECT count(queue.id) FROM porion_build_queue AS queue

query.name: project-build-queue-list
query.comment: Get a description of the build queue for a given project
query.sql: SELECT queue.id AS id, queue.`order` AS `order`, queue.create_date AS create_date, queue.building AS building, project.name AS name, project.status AS status, branch.name AS branch_name, branch.tag AS branch_tag, branch.status AS branch_status, recipe.id AS recipe_id, recipe.name AS recipe_name, recipe.status AS recipe_status, recipe.main_recipe AS main_recipe, node.name AS node_name, node.status AS node_status FROM porion_build_queue AS queue INNER JOIN porion_node AS node ON queue.node_id = node.id INNER JOIN porion_recipe AS recipe ON queue.recipe_id = recipe.id INNER JOIN porion_project AS project ON recipe.project_id = project.id INNER JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON recipe.branch_id = branch.id WHERE project.id = :project_id ORDER BY queue.`order` ASC, queue.create_date ASC

query.name: node-build-queue-list
query.comment: Get a description of the build queue for a given build node
query.sql: SELECT queue.id AS id, queue.`order` AS `order`, queue.create_date AS create_date, queue.building AS building, project.name AS name, project.status AS status, branch.name AS branch_name, branch.tag AS branch_tag, branch.status AS branch_status, recipe.id AS recipe_id, recipe.name AS recipe_name, recipe.status AS recipe_status, recipe.main_recipe AS main_recipe, node.name AS node_name, node.status AS node_status FROM porion_build_queue AS queue INNER JOIN porion_node AS node ON queue.node_id = node.id INNER JOIN porion_recipe AS recipe ON queue.recipe_id = recipe.id INNER JOIN porion_project AS project ON recipe.project_id = project.id INNER JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON recipe.branch_id = branch.id WHERE node.id = :node_id ORDER BY queue.`order` ASC, queue.create_date ASC
